findings.summary: Node-local missing profile has no authoritative initialization-eligibility source across node movement/state loss
findings.evidence: design.md54–61,71–74,89–90; Header has no mode/history; FirstEpoch identifies incarnation only
findings.fix: Define trusted durable cross-node initialization grant/history and how new volumes obtain it; unknown/raw-used/missing history must never be reformatted; test fresh node and erased local profile

findings.summary: Ordinary pathname unmount assumes unspecified cooperation with kubelet/other namespace writers
findings.fix: Concrete enforceable coordination or verified Kubernetes serialization contract/deployment constraints, with successful normal cleanup and concurrent external-writer tests

findings.summary: Reordered stage pin/profile before reservation loses durable intent before attachment
findings.evidence: design.md54–57,89–90; node.device attaches before authoritative tuple can be learned
findings.fix: Durably reserve initial operation before attach, then bind tuple/profile; define lost reply recovery and crash/profile-write failure cases

prior_findings: All nine R1 corrections are explicit; same-node formatting and mount-FD mechanical failures resolved, but new history/coordination approaches remain incomplete.
